page.overview:
Who is Dinky Doo?

Dinky Doo is the placeholder name given to a filly unicorn seen in several episodes engaging in activities with other foals. Dinky Doo has a pale purple coat color, a blonde mane, and yellow eyes. She has sported many cutie marks including a pillow, an archer's bow, a horseshoe, a pair of dolphins, and sometimes no cutie mark at all.__TOC__

Dinky Doo features the eye model of a standard adult mare rather than a filly. She shares her design with "Ruby Pinch" and Liza Doolots.

Dinky was to appear in Friendship is Magic, part 2 along with "Tornado Bolt", Cotton Cloudy, "Princess Erroria", "Noi", Aura, and Liza Doolots, as well as Prim Posy, Lemony Gem, "Serena", "Pinkie Feather", "Rainy Feather", "Mango Dash", and "Sweet Pop".

Dinky Doo is often a crowd-filler. She makes her debut appearance in Winter Wrap Up, jumping up and down while singing the song. In the next episode, Call of the Cutie, Dinky Doo is shown multiple times, although in each shot Dinky Doo has a different cutie mark.
